ingredients.name: Raw plain unbreaded basa fillets, no seasoning or marinade

instructions: Check the current resident instructions and every ingredient package, including precautionary allergen statements. A plain recipe is not an allergen-free guarantee. If a product or substitution cannot be checked, stop and ask the kitchen lead; do not infer suitability from this name.

Wash hands. Physically clean, rinse and sanitise the work surface, board, probe, pan and utensils before starting. Use fresh parchment and separate clean utensils; prepare away from excluded ingredients. Keep raw meat/fish separate from produce and cooked food. No shared frying oil, stock, marinades, seasoning blends, butter or sauces.
Check the fish product ingredients; reject a seasoned, breaded, coated or injected product for this plain formula. Thaw under the kitchen cold-storage procedure. Inspect for bones.

Arrange in a single layer in a clean parchment-lined pan, add the measured water and cover. Bake at 180 °C (356 °F), beginning checks after about 12 minutes. Check each thickest portion with a clean probe to 70 °C (158 °F). Continue as needed; do not use the clock alone.
Remove any remaining bones carefully. Portion with a separate fish utensil; prepare the texture only to the current resident instruction. Do not add the main meal sauce.

Keep this batch covered and labelled with its dish and intended recipient/service. Use separate serving utensils. Serve hot at 60 °C (140 °F) or above; if holding or cooling is needed, use the kitchen HACCP procedure and record temperatures. Do not infer a storage life from this recipe.

ingredients.name: Raw unseasoned chicken legs, one whole leg per intended portion

instructions: Check the current resident instructions and every ingredient package, including precautionary allergen statements. A plain recipe is not an allergen-free guarantee. If a product or substitution cannot be checked, stop and ask the kitchen lead; do not infer suitability from this name.

Wash hands. Physically clean, rinse and sanitise the work surface, board, probe, pan and utensils before starting. Use fresh parchment and separate clean utensils; prepare away from excluded ingredients. Keep raw meat/fish separate from produce and cooked food. No shared frying oil, stock, marinades, seasoning blends, butter or sauces.
Do not wash raw chicken. Place legs in a single layer on a parchment-lined tray with the measured water; cover for the first part of cooking. Do not add oil, salt, pepper, stock, marinade or spice.

Roast at 180 °C (356 °F). Start checking after about 40 minutes; size and oven loading change the time. Check each leg in its thickest part away from bone with a clean probe: at least 74 °C (165 °F). Continue until tender; time alone is not the endpoint.

Rest briefly in the covered clean pan. For an approved deboned/soft preparation, remove every bone, cartilage and skin as directed, and prepare the meat to the resident instruction with clean utensils. Retain only this batch cooking juices; do not add a standard sauce.

Keep this batch covered and labelled with its dish and intended recipient/service. Use separate serving utensils. Serve hot at 60 °C (140 °F) or above; if holding or cooling is needed, use the kitchen HACCP procedure and record temperatures. Do not infer a storage life from this recipe.
